name: BTC MAX(10) NYSE-close daily hold
author: Cyril Dujava / QuantPedia
instruments_timeframes_claimed: BTC; NYSE trading days, daily close observations
indicators: 10-day rolling high using BTC observations aligned to NYSE sessions
entry_long: At NYSE 16:00 close, buy if BTC is at a 10-session local high.
exit: Exit next NYSE session open after one overnight hold.
claimed_performance: Source reports >35% OOS performance with about -12% maximum drawdown; source sample ends 2024 and is self-selected.
implementation_notes: Gemini BTC prices aligned to NYSE calendar; actual ETF closes were not used. Define high equality and execution costs.
